sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; StagedWorkspace was selected after Agent Lightning and HarnessRisk were found already present on current origin/data.
Read arXiv abstract page, HTML full text, TeX source, generated result tables, and appendix protocol sections.
Extracted W_t, C_t, Delta_t state contract, hash-keyed freshness, tool routing arms, benchmark protocols, ablations, and residual failure slice.
Cross-checked arXiv current listing and third-party arXiv aggregators; third-party sources were used only for discovery/date corroboration.
Preserved boundaries on non-causal leaderboard comparison, parser/retriever coupling, outcome-only grading, cost accounting, and all-arm-zero residuals.
Markdown passed the 5000 CJK gate with tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no images were required for evidence.
